semantic.justification: TaskQXFX41 ports original ScInputMode NONE0 TYPE1 TABLE2 TOP3 and bounded ScInputHandler mode predicates/toggle at native source boundaries. Browser scalar input shares one draft:TYPE arrows commit/move,TABLE and TOP keep caret navigation. Original SID_SETINPUTMODE26552 and F2 use the same shared-menu dispatcher;TYPE/TABLE toggles preserve draft/history,TOP commits before TABLE and rejected input retains mode/error. GetMode is a read-only browser projection of eMode,not an upstream method. EditEngine,protection,formula reference selection,autocomplete and VCL synchronization remain unported;no full native input parity is claimed. TaskEJ2ZC1 replaces browser JSON equality gating with native input bModified lifecycle. Constructor false and source SetModified mark actual input;F2,focus and caret-only mode changes preserve the flag without writes. Accepted input uses native EnterHandler2 bOldMod guard;explicit replacement or changed-and-reverted text creates actual Undo even when final values are equal,as native SetNormalStringOperation does. Cancel,accepted input,history and model replacement reset modification;rejected drafts retain it. IsModified/ResetModified are explicit browser read/lifecycle projections of native private flag operations,not full upstream handlers. EditEngine,validation/autocorrect,format services and complete input/undo operation ownership remain unported.
